title: Act: Add the Zustand game store, move useGame onto it and add BootScene
summary: Store GameState in Zustand; BootScene reads it without copying.
description: Create gameStore, refactor useGame to use it and add a Phaser scene that reads from it.
acceptance_criteria: Given useGame, When read, Then state comes from useGameStore.
Given BootScene, When read, Then it keeps no GameState field.

steps.action: Create a zustand store with interface GameStoreState {state: GameState | null; setState: (updater: (prev: GameState) => GameState) => void; init: (s: GameState) => void}. init sets state only when state is null; setState applies updater to the current non-null state.
steps.code:
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { GameState } from '@game/state/types';
steps.expected: useGameStore.getState().state is null until init is called.

steps.action: Remove the useState call. Compute the initial value readSaved() ?? createInitialState(world, scene) and call useGameStore.getState().init(initial) before reading. Select state with useGameStore((s)=>s.state) as GameState. Keep the writeSaved useEffect on state. Change act to useGameStore.getState().setState((prev)=>performAction(prev, scene, objectId, actionId)) and choose to the equivalent with chooseOption. Keep the return object keys unchanged.
steps.code: before: setState((prev) => performAction(...)) -> after: useGameStore.getState().setState((prev) => performAction(prev, scene, objectId, actionId))
steps.expected: useGame returns the same keys and updates through the store.

steps.action: Create class BootScene extends Phaser.Scene with constructor super('BootScene'), private unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null (not state), readState(): GameState | null returning useGameStore.getState().state, create() that subscribes with this.unsubscribe = useGameStore.subscribe(() => this.onStateChange()) and emits phaserToReact.emit('sceneReady',{sceneId:'boot'}), onStateChange() that calls this.readState(), and in create registers this.events.once(Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, () => {this.unsubscribe?.(); this.unsubscribe = null;}).
steps.expected: BootScene never stores a GameState field and unsubscribes on shutdown.
